variants: Base: image + text cards in a responsive grid.
variants.feature: Text-only feature tiles (solid brand-blue); whole tile clickable when the body contains a link.

suitableFor: grids of repeating item tiles (image + title + text)
text-only clickable feature/navigation tiles (use the 'feature' variant)
notSuitableFor: a single call-to-action (use a button in default content or columns)
